title: Installation.
officialText:
Clothes dryers shall be exhausted in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. Dryer exhaust systems shall
be independent of all other systems and shall convey the moisture and any products of combustion to the outside of the building.
Exception: This section shall not apply to listed and labeled condensing (ductless) clothes dryers.
